user.title: Fridge Vision Inventory
user.description: Connect the integration to the Fridge Vision AI add-on. The default URL works when the add-on runs on the same Home Assistant OS instance ({example_url}).

data_description.ai_service_url: Base URL of the add-on API, e.g. {example_url}. Check the Fridge Vision AI add-on page for the exact hostname.
data_description.camera_entity: Camera used to grab frames while the door is open.
data_description.door_sensor_entity: Binary sensor reporting door state (on = open).
data_description.capture_fps: Frames per second captured during door-open (1-10).
data_description.motion_vector_insert_direction: Direction the hand moves when inserting items: top_to_bottom or bottom_to_top.
data_description.confidence_threshold: Minimum detection confidence (0.05-0.95) required to change the inventory.
data_description.notify_device: Notify target for ambiguous movements, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone. Leave empty to skip notifications.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Vision AI service. Start the Fridge Vision AI add-on first and check the URL.

abort.already_configured: Fridge Vision Inventory is already configured.

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Adds an inventory item and re-parameterizes the AI model with all configured AI prompts.

name.name: Name
name.description: Display name of the product, e.g. "Mleko 3.2%".

ai_prompt.name: AI prompt
ai_prompt.description: English detection prompt for YOLO-World, e.g. "milk carton".

update_quantity.name: Update quantity
update_quantity.description: Increments or decrements the quantity of an inventory item.

delta.name: Delta
delta.description: Amount to add (use a negative value to subtract; clamped at 0).

delete_item.name: Delete item
delete_item.description: Removes an inventory item and re-parameterizes the AI model.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: ID of the inventory item to delete.

reparameterize_model.name: Reparameterize model
reparameterize_model.description: Gathers all unique AI prompts from the inventory and pushes them to the Vision AI add-on via /api/set_classes.
